description: IBM Carbon-inspired colorscheme. This plugin is a pure colorscheme with no setup API.
author: nyoom-engineering
tagline: Clean Carbon-inspired palette with dark and light variants

options.label: Variant / Flavor
options.description: Dark or light background before applying the oxocarbon colorscheme.

functions.name: apply

params.name: variant
params.description: Background style (dark or light); defaults to dark.

functions.luaCall: local v = $params.variant or 'dark'; vim.o.background = v; vim.cmd('colorscheme oxocarbon')
